title: warden ten-drills
description: Warden now has only ten drills, but no tendrils. Yeah...
body:
## What??

Yeah, you heard it right. I surgecally removed warden's tendrils and replaced them with ten drills. He's now very annoying, like my neighbor.

## What do I even do with this resourcepack?

Enjoy. Just enjoy warden's ten drills.
